question: After the merged Web UI session-thread work, what residual scope should this broad topic/session management issue own?
rationale: Current main solves several Web UI and chat-naming slices, but the remaining TUI, CLI, metadata, and import/export semantics require product ownership before implementation can be safely queued.

options.title: Keep broad residual tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer-scoped residual work across TUI, CLI, metadata, and import/export while treating merged Web UI work as partial implementation.

options.title: Split and close umbrella
options.body: Create narrower follow-up issues for the remaining surfaces, then close this broad tracker once those canonical follow-ups are linked.

options.title: Declare Web UI scope sufficient
options.body: Treat the merged Web UI/sidebar/picker thread management as enough and close the issue, leaving TUI, CLI, import-export, and richer topic metadata out of scope.

recommendation.title: Keep broad residual tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer-scoped residual work across TUI, CLI, metadata, and import/export while treating merged Web UI work as partial implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current session-thread management foundation and are the clearest current owner for deciding whether the remaining broad scope stays here or splits.
